description: Daniel Gafni's personal website: blog posts and projects

items.content_html: The first part of a hands-on tutorial on building a production-grade Kubernetes cluster on AWS EKS for data and ML workloads, set up entirely with Terraform and published with the complete source code.
items.title: Cloud Computing with EKS: Cluster Setup

items.content_html: How to structure a Python monorepo with uv workspaces and build per-project Docker images with Dagger, reading uv.lock to copy in only the packages each project needs so builds stay cached.
items.title: Cracking the Python Monorepo

items.content_html: A pointer to an article on the Dagster blog that shows how to use functools.wraps to write custom asset decorators and build configurable asset factories.
items.title: Unlocking Flexible Pipelines: Customizing the Asset Decorator

items.content_html: An updated version of a 2022 Medium article on replacing a classic zsh and tmux terminal setup with modern cross-platform command-line tools written in Rust, and what each one does better.
items.title: The Modern CLI Stack
